message.content:
As of the latest information available (early 2026), Tesla’s official pricing for the Model S in India is set at **₹1.50 crore** (about $18,000 USD).  

> **Key points**  
> • The price includes the base Model S Long‑Range variant; higher trims (e.g., Plaid) will cost more.  
> • It covers the vehicle itself plus applicable taxes, registration, and delivery fees.  
> • Prices are subject to change based on local tax adjustments, import duties, and Tesla’s own pricing strategy.  

If you’re planning a purchase, it’s a good idea to check Tesla’s Indian website or contact a local Tesla dealer for the most up‑to‑date quote and any promotional offers that may apply.
